notes.title: LOVE Update #19
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 2014's hot indie game LOVE is getting yet another update! The kind folks at Epic Games requested the game for a free giveaway on their Store (happening this week), and with the compensation they gave us, we were able to take some time to polish the game up for all PC versions of the game, with some excellent updates.

Thank you all so much for your decade of support. I hope that this update will allow players to enjoy the game again, create new experiences for one another, and find new players to enlighten and enfrustrate.

You can find me and the many things I'm working on at [url=https://FredTWood.com]FredTWood.com[/url]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
• All audio has been replaced with the best versions we could find, and James has created new looping versions of the tracks. Don't worry, they still start the same every time, so if you've been running the game for nine years and have subconsciously timed your muscle memory to the beat of the music, you're good. Music is also now loaded from external files, so it should also load faster.

• The old LOVE Custom has been replaced with a new LOVE Custom in the style of LOVE 3 Custom. Now you'll be able to create, download, and share new levels for LOVE with great ease. You can find new levels and the Wiki with documentation at [url=https://LOVE3Custom.com]LOVE3Custom.com[/url]. Included with the game are the 10 original Remix levels, slightly adjusted to work with the modern version of LOVE.

• Controller Support Update: We've moved to Input 5.6.1 by Juju Adams and Alynne Keith. Now the game works with every controller I've thrown at it, from a Super Famicom Controller with a Daemonbites Adapter to a PlayStation 5 Dual Sense controller.

• Keyboard Remapping: You can press Shift+F6 at any time to pull up the keyboard remap menu, or you can access it from the main menu. It's not perfect, but it's leagues better than it used to be.

• YOLO Medals: You can now get YOLO Medals for LOVE, LOVE RMX, and the 3 LOVE 2: kuso demakes.

• Achievements Menu: Your achievements are now saved locally, so if you're offline when you finally get that YOLO Achievement, it will be synced when you are online. You can also find stats like how many times you've died and how many bouncers you've jumped on in the new achievements Menu.

• Scoring Update: The original version of the game's scoring was pretty dang bad, so it's been updated. You get bonus points for not using checkpoints, not dying, and going fast. Your high scores are now saved and displayed in the Game Select menu.

The achievement ranks are:
     A++: 11985
     A: 9240
     B: 6493
     C: 3747

• Speedrun Update: Because of some cheating using old builds and debug mode, we're moving to new leaderboards. Old leaderboards are still visible for now, and will be archived eventually.

• Menu Updates: I've learned a lot in the last 9 years, and now all the menus work much better, and are a little less static. Things like pressing up at the top of a menu to wrap to the bottom, and having some intelligence around remembering what menu you came from and having the option selected.

• LOVE Classic: In April 2020 I recoded the whole game to run at 60fps since all game logic is tied to the framerate, and I also updated some rules like checkpoints being able to be killed. Now you can also play LOVE Classic, which removes all of these quality of life improvements to bring the game back to 2014 -- but I updated the menus and added full controller support to make it not feel quite so ancient. The game is untouched, though! LOVE Classic doesn't have Steamworks support, so no achievements or Leaderboards for that version.

• Secrets: The church is tucked away again, and Flappy LOVE has slightly better controls, for no particularly good reason.

notes.title: LOVE Update #18
notes.content:
Note: Ah dang, ah jeez -- Steamworks is broken in this build. I've got a fixed version ready to go, but something in the Steamworks backend is stopping me from uploading the build. Please hold off on your YOLO runs for the meantime.

Hey all, happy to share that I've got a small update for LOVE. I've had some reports from players that the previous version was starting to run a bit funky with modern systems and displays running higher than 60hz, so I've updated the game's build to the latest version of Game Maker, which should alleviate some of those woes. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604300/LOVE_3/]LOVE 3[/url] does not have these problems, but I believe [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]LOVE 2: kuso[/url] still does, so I'll be working on that next when I have time.

I also made a small tweak to Level 4's secret area in Arcade and Unlimited Mode. Just trying to keep up with the times.

I hope y'all enjoy, and please let me know if you run into any other problems. Thanks!

notes.title: LOVE Update #17 - LOVE, now in 9 Languages
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Welcome to LOVE
[*] Bienvenido a LOVE
[*] Bienvenue à LOVE
[*] Welkom bij LOVE
[*] Willkommen zu LOVE
[*] Добро пожаловать в LOVE
[*] Bem Vindo ao LOVE
[*] Ласкаво просимо в LOVE
[*] Velkommen til LOVE.
[/olist]

Thanks to the help of players and friends, LOVE has now been translated into 9 different languages including English, Español, Français, Nederlands, Deutsche, русский, Português, українська, & Dansk. All menus and results screens have been translated, though the Tutorial is still currently in need of a total overhaul to work with variable text.

But that's not all -- every menu has been completely redone. Now instead of having to exit back to the main menu to adjust sound settings or screen settings, you can access most of the game's options from the pause screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5621940/34aff6ed6d1046a1daedc5898055685bbd923e71.gif[/img]

If you haven't touched LOVE in a while (you'd be forgiven since the game came out six years ago), you might have also missed the update which brought the game's framerate up to 60fps, instead of the difficult to stomach 30fps that I hard-coded the game to in 2014. You can read [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/269270/announcements/detail/2111566192459225837]that update here[/url].

Did you know that in 2017 we released a sequel to LOVE with a whole new soundtrack from James Bennett? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]You can pick up LOVE 2: kuso on Steam[/url] or [url=http://kuso.ge]Nintendo Switch[/url] and enjoy more LOVE with the benefit of 3 years of game dev experience.

Maybe you're already very familiar with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]LOVE 2: kuso[/url]. Maybe you're looking for more. Well, don't worry, sometime in 2021, we're droppin' this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5621940/2f5397196c3ce70e501e79c45b5ffdbad1b4eb48.png[/img]

It'll be localized in multiple languages, have all the quality of life improvements I've made to LOVE and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]LOVE 2: kuso[/url], and have all sorts of new challenges and secrets that I never could have pulled off in 2014 or 2017. LOVE 3 will be the best game I've ever made, and we've been working on it for a while. I can't wait to show you more than a placeholder logo on a photo from a street in Tokyo. And hopefully it'll be soon.

If you want to swap tips and tricks and join a chill community of like-minded players, come join the [url=https://discord.gg/DcrfC9j]LOVE Discord Channel[/url]. Lots of good people in there.

Thanks for the years of support, you're all the best.

notes.title: LOVE Update #16 - Now at 60 FPS
notes.content:
LOVE 2.0.0a

Happy April Fools day, y'all. The world's in a rough state, so rather than play a trick on you, I've played a trick on myself. Since 2014 folks have been asking for LOVE to run at 60 frames per second instead of 30, and I've wanted to do it, but it's never been as simple as flipping a switch. All of the game's logic is tied to its framerate, which is a big part of why the game feels as good as it does. In order to run at 60, every single moving or animated object has to be recoded to the new framerate. For the most part that's a matter of dividing each number by two, but for some of my very poorly coded objects it wasn't quite so simple.

But I did it. I took the time and recoded every single object in the game to run at 60 frames per second, and it feels marvelous. The weight of shame has been lifted from my shoulders, and I can once again recommend that people play LOVE instead of just asking them to please, please, please play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]LOVE 2: kuso[/url] instead. Now there's enough reason to suggest new players to check out LOVE to see what's changed between it and its sequel.

Why put in the effort on a SIX YEAR OLD video game? Well, because of y'all. All 118,000+ folks who have LOVE across Steam, [url=https://thatsmytrunks.itch.io/love]Itch.io[/url], [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/love-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url], and even [url=https://thatsmytrunks.itch.io/love/devlog/133739/love-now-on-ouya-again]Ouya[/url]. If I have the opportunity to make something better for that many people, I'd be a fool not to.

So here's a free update to a game you've had for a while. Maybe you never even played the previous version of the game, and if so,  here's a great new game to play. And since I had to go through all this effort, I also cleaned up a lot of the other parts of the game, and fixed bugs that have been bugging me since 2014.

Changes:
• The game runs at a full 60fps now. No, I won't be supporting 120fps.
• The game's also been ported to Linux / SteamOS.
• All objects now update and function at 60fps.
[strike]• The game has moved to Game Maker Studio 2's YYC compiler instead of the VM one, which should result in better performance.[/strike]
••• Edit: YYC broke so many things for so many people, moving back to VM.
• Coyote Frames have been added as a quality of life improvement. This gives the player five additional frames (One-twelfth of a second) after walking off a platform to hit the jump button.
• Your checkpoint can die now, so don't leave it sitting under some acid or on a disappearing platform
• Bouncers now affect your momentum whether you have already jumped or are falling, and you can't accidentally make yourself fly downward.
• Removed a bug where a player could keep their vertical position as long as they let go of the jump button every frame forever.
• The scoring system has been completely revamped and is now much more clear.
• Due to the reworking of the physics, the leaderboards have been completely reset.
• One of the bonus levels was removed.
• Three bonus stages (demakes) from kuso have been added
• Leaderboards for the three kuso stages have been added
• The options menu has been completely replaced with a far more functional one. You can adjust audio levels, and screen scaling.

I still have some small updates in mind for LOVE, but for now my focus is elsewhere: [i]LOVE 3 has begun development[/i]. In the meantime, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/LOVE_2_kuso/]LOVE 2: kuso[/url], and my other title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1188000/Pulstario/]Pulstario[/url]. They could use your appreciation.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your years of support. If you wanna talk with me, reach out via Twitter ([url=http://twitter.com/thatsmytrunks]@thatsmytrunks[/url]) or e-mail me at fred.t.wood at gmail dot com. [url=https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np]We've also got a Discord[/url] where we talk about all sorts of stuff, so [url=https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np]come join us[/url]. I hope to keep making games that you enjoy playing.

notes.title: LOVE Update #14 (and kuso Announcement!)
notes.content:
[i]Dusts off keyboard[/i]

Oh, hey. [i]Hi.[/i] It's Fred. It's been a while.

I imagine you might be surprised when you see that a game is updating in your Steam library, only to find that it's the 2014 release, [b]LOVE[/b]. Didn't I say I was done supporting this game? Turns out that might've been a tiny fib.

Let me get this exciting announcement out there first: [h1]There's a substantial, [i]free[/i] update coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/kuso/][b]kuso[/b][/url] later this year.[/h1] New levels, new features, new modes, new music, new ways to play, and new secrets. I've been hard at work on this update since the day we launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/kuso/]kuso[/url] last November, and I'm really excited for you to play it -- later this year. If you haven't picked up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/kuso/][b]kuso[/b][/url] yet, please do! I truly feel that as a sequel to [i]LOVE[/i], it improves on the format in every single way.

But that's kuso. This update is about [i]LOVE[/i]. And why it just downloaded a patch. What's that all about? Well, while working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/kuso/]kuso[/url]'s new features, I learned a lot of things that I realized would fit perfectly into [i]LOVE[/i]without messing up the original game, so I wanted to take some time this week and fit some new features in. Time for some patch notes!

[b]• Customizable Keyboard Controls.[/b]
--- This has been a long requested fix, and while the implementation is a little hack-y, it works. Press Shift+F6 in game, and it'll take you to a room where you can rebind or reset your keyboard controls. Do note that the game won't show those keys in menus and things, but they will function perfectly.

[b]• Individual Leaderboards for Level-Specific Speedrunning[/b]
--- This is something I'm very excited about. I personally can't compete with the world record for all of [i]LOVE[/i], but I can sure as hell beat Level 2 very fast. And now I can compete with you on an official level, as Steam now has Leaderboards for every individual level.

[b]• RETRY and New Pause Menu[/b]
--- In Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2, when you want to chase a high score, you're likely to hit start and select retry hundreds of times. When chasing a speedrun high score, you'll want to do that too. I've completely redone the pause menu to not only look nicer, but function better too.

[b]• Local Configuration Settings[/b]
--- This one's an embarrassing fix for bad programming. Instead of calling for Steam's stats when you boot up the game, it'll check your local files for it. You can even edit your config.cfg by hand if you want. Want to set the windowed version of the game to a 40x multiplier? Go nuts. I won't try to stop you.

[b]• Audio Levels[/b]
--- I've had a number of streamers request this for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578930/kuso/]kuso[/url], so while I'm still working on that update, I've included it here in [i]LOVE[/i]as well. Now you can turn the sound effects to a whisper while blasting [url=http://jamesben.net]James' excellent music[/url].

[b]• New Tutorial Level[/b]
--- The original tutorial level was bad and didn't explain the respawn mechanic. It's been completely replaced.

[b]• Better Input Handling[/b]
--- LOVE wasn't designed for a Game Pad, and when it got Game Pad support, it was poorly implemented. While it still only supports xInput by default, moving around menus should feel much, much better.

[b]• New Menus[/b]
--- While they aren't massively different, all the menus have been touched up and refined -- or completely replaced.

[b]• Optimized In-Game HUD[/b]
--- The original Lives and Timer counters have been replaced by some much more flexible and nicer-to-look assets.

[b]• [i]Flappy LOVE[/i] Leaderboards[/b]
--- Compete for a high score in the hidden mini game that (by looking at the metrics) very few people have found. No spoiling it in the comments, please.

And for now, that's it! While I don't intend to add anything more to [i]LOVE[/i], only time will tell. I'm so thankful to the thousands of players who have picked up [i]LOVE[/i] and enjoyed it, and I hope that these updates are substantial enough to entertain you while I work on the upcoming content for kuso.

If you're a Discord user, I highly recommend joining the LOVE & kuso Discord Channel (https://discord.gg/jHhX6Np). We post snippets and teasers of things we're working on, and love to chat about other stuff we're excited about. Just please check the #rules channel before posting.

Thank you for reading, and see you again soon.

notes.title: kuso Demo and Love Update #13
notes.content:
I'm excited to share some great news: the sequel to LOVE, which I am affectionately naming [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/578930][i][b]kuso[/b][/i][/url]. 

I have a lot to say about the game, and you can read some of that in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/578930/announcements/detail/641035011396545635]the announcement on the game's page[/url], but more important than words are actions: You can go [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/578930]download the demo for [i]kuso[/i] right now[/url] for [i]free[/i].

I think that fans of [b]LOVE[/b] will find [i]kuso[/i] to be everything you'd want a sequel of [b]LOVE[/b] to be, and I'm excited to be making video games again.

Also I've pushed an update for [b]LOVE[/b] (Update #13) that has some minor quality of life fixes.

• Control Improvements in Menus
• Moved the Suicide Button to D
• Improved Spawn Point Placement while playing with Joystick
• Changed the way Screenshots work internally.
• Fixed Small, mostly imperceptible bugs
• Removed one row of pixels from the lower ceiling in Level 9 because I've always hated it and it deserves to be gone.

Thank you so much for your support, you high scores, and your feedback for the last couple of years. I hope to make you proud with [i]kuso[/i].

notes.title: LOVE Update #12 - Small Fixes and a Bonus Level
notes.content:
Hey, Fred here with another small update. Here's the notes:
• New Bonus Level, 1-1
• 1-1 added to Level Select
• Retry Button on Game Over / Results Screen
• Clarified hazards in Level 1 (and added sounds!)
• Added directional hazards to Level 2
• Level 16 bullets fire 3.3 times per second instead of 5 times per second
• Misc Fixes

1-1 is only a fun little side thing I did in a Sunday afternoon, but hopefully you'll enjoy it. You can access it from the Level Select menu under "Bonus Levels". The other level hazard modifications address the only things I've ever considered "unfair" in the game, and I hope that'll sate new players' rage when they give it their first go.

If you'd like to get in touch with me, Twitter's a great way, so feel free to follow me at [url=http://twitter.com/thatsmytrunks]@thatsmytrunks[/url]. Have a great day, and enjoy!

notes.title: LOVE Update #11 - Alternative Money Spending Techniques
notes.content:
Hey, Fred Wood here. I hope you're all enjoying LOVE, getting achievements, and setting speedrun records. I've had a number of requests for merchandise of different kinds, so I've got a couple of updates on that front:

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/408590/][b]LOVE Soundtrack[/b][/url] 
 ▪ The Soundtrack for LOVE is now available in the highest quality we could muster, with the full versions of every track found in the game. I've combed through various files sent to me by James since about 2006, and I think that this really is the ultimate collection of the LOVE Soundtrack.
 ▪ As a bonus, there's a Side B Collection that comes free with the soundtrack that includes a bunch of, well, B-Sides that have been used in different LOVE builds, and an alternate cut of one of the LOVE tracks. 

[b]LOVE Decals[/b] (from [url=FredsDecals.com]FredsDecals.com[/url])
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/79396/loveCharacter.png[/img]
 ▪ I've started a side business (because I'm a big fan of being busy all the time) of creating high quality custom-cut decals! While working with the fine folks at Vlambeer on their decals, I decided to make a couple of my own, so you can find the LOVE Logo or the LOVE Player decals at my site.


And in other news, I've been able to get LOVE up and running on Mac AND Linux, though I'm running into trouble with actually distributing the game. I haven't figured out how to deploy the game properly to Steam from the respective platforms, and I don't have a dedicated Linux box ([i]yet[/i]). I know that there are many players who want to be able to play LOVE on their Macbooks and otherwise, so I want to get this working, and I want to make it available to you. 


Thanks for all of your support, and if you find yourself needing some people talking in your ear I've got a couple of suggestions for ya:
 ▪ The Bancast - TheBancast.com
 ▪ The Lone Stars Podcast - LoneStarsPodcast.com
Both are shows I work on, and I'd love it if you'd give them a try.

Thanks for your time, and I love you all very much.

notes.title: Love Update #7, Now With More Love
notes.content:
Love has been updated to include three brand new levels, as well as a few minor aesthetic tweaks. I intend to have two more levels done soon, as well.

The levels are accessible from the Level Select Menu (which has been revamped), which unlocks and is displayed on the main menu once you've gotten the Game Cleared achievement.

For those worried about your Speedrun times being affected by the addition of these new levels, don't worry for now. They're not part of the main game quite yet, but once I've added all the levels I plan to add, the leaderboards will be frozen, archived, and reset.

I hope you've been enjoying Love, and as always, I'm open to your comments. The best way to reach me is probably via Twitter, where I can be found as [url=http://twitter.com/thatsmytrunks]@thatsmytrunks[/url].

And if you haven't checked out my podcast, [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/the-bancast/id875449552]why not give [i]The Bancast[/i] a listen[/url]?

notes.title: Love Update #5, Love on Valentine's Day
notes.content:
This Valentine's Day brings Love out of Early Access, as well as introduces a couple of quick fixes and new features.

Changes:
- When playing an individual level from Level Select, the player now has unlimited lives.
- Controller responsiveness has increased
- Bugs present in the bonus game are now gone
- Love now has Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, and Profile Backgrounds. Read more about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards]Steam Trading Cards[/url] here.

I hope you spend this day with someone or doing something you love. If playing and competing in challenging games is your bag, we've extended the $2.00 price tag through next Friday, so Love is cheap.

notes.title: Love Update #3
notes.content:
Update #3 is a little light on the fixes, but one has been plaguing the game for some time. Now Keyboard users can obtain the Overly Cautious achievement like their gamepad bretheren. Also, a glitch that said you had -9 million deaths in Speedrun Mode has been fixed. Just a little bad math on my part.

I expect Love to be out of Early Access by Friday, with a nice little feature being included.

As always, bugs and other issues can be [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269270/discussions/0/540732889456453326]reported here[/url], and you can [url=https://twitter.com/intent/user?screen_name=thatsmytrunks]follow me[/url] / tweet at me on Twitter as [url=https://twitter.com/thatsmytrunks]@ThatsMyTrunks[/url].

Fixes:
- Overly Cautious Achievement is now tracking properly for everyone
- Speedrun "Number of Deaths" math fixed
- [i]Edit: Fixed the pause menu for joysticks.[/i]

Known Bugs:
- [strike]The pause screen is hard navigate use for players using joysticks[/strike] 
- No way to see Leaderboard ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269270/discussions/0/540732889444561916/]Read this thread[/url] for how to find your position)
- Steam Screenshots not implemented

I hope to have solutions for the last 3 known bugs soon. Until then, [strike]use the DPad in the pause menu[/strike], [url=http://steamidfinder.com/]find your Steam ID[/url] and cross-check it against the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269270/discussions/0/540732889444561916/]XML[/url] files to find your place on the leaderboards, and print screen and paste in MS Paint to take a screenshot.

Take care, and enjoy.

Quick edit: Fixed it!

notes.title: Love Update #2
notes.content:
Here's the second big update to squash some pesky bugs.

Fixes:
 - Escape now brings up the pause menu instead of quitting.
 - Bouncer Sound Effect has been replaced with something quieter and less irritating.
 - Speedrun / Level Select stuff works properly now.
 - Fixed SFX/Music Enable/Disable settings
 - Changed a few pixels in Level 10. Nothing huge.
 - Moved LoveCustom to its own folder in the steamapps/common/Love folder.
 - Added an option in Steam's Launch to open the LoveCustom folder.

Known Issues:
 - The pause screen is difficult to navigate for players using joysticks
 - No way to publicly access Leaderboard Progress yet
 - Overly Cautious isn't working for everyone

If you happen upon a bug or problem that isn't listed here, please leave a comment in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269270/discussions/0/540732889456453326/]Bug Report Thread[/url] in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269270]Love Community Hub[/url].

If you'd like to get in touch with me directly for any reason, my twitter handle is [url=https://twitter.com/thatsmytrunks]@ThatsMyTrunks[/url], and I check it far too often. [url=https://twitter.com/intent/user?screen_name=thatsmytrunks]Follow me[/url] if you'd like.

notes.title: Love Update #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've been actively checking the community hub for Love, listening to thoughts and issues and bug fix requests, and after a bit of tweaking last night and today, I've made some updates to Love.

Fixes:
- Added a Pause Menu
- Added a Controls Screen at launch to help confused players
- Fixed the achievement text for the Low Road
- Clarified the Achievement text for The Direct Approach and Shortcut Taker
- Fixed the Slacker and Day Dreamer achievements for players who got A Ranks.
- There was an audio problem here, it's gone now.

Known Issues
- The pause screen is hard navigate use for players using joysticks
- Overly Cautious isn't working for everyone
- Sometimes the enable Music / enable SFX options don't save properly
- Playing in Speedrun Mode and playing in the Level Select can cause wonkyness.

Continue posting your thoughts and wishes in the community hub, and I'll keep listening. Thanks for picking up the game during this Early Access period, and I promise to keep working on the game.
